g.text: DS1 DNP: OLED module supplied in kit, user-soldered. Fed 3.3 V from LP2985 OLED rail.

g.desc: DS1 DNP: OLED module supplied in kit, user-soldered. Fed 3.3 V from LP2985 OLED rail.

g.text: PCB: print pin names on silkscreen at DS1 header (GND,VCC,CLK,MOSI,RES,DC,CS); suppliers vary.

g.desc: PCB: print pin names on silkscreen at DS1 header (GND,VCC,CLK,MOSI,RES,DC,CS); suppliers vary.

g.text: Pin 1 = VCC reference for programmer; board must be USB-powered while programming.

g.desc: Pin 1 = VCC reference for programmer; board must be USB-powered while programming.

g.text: OLED: SPI only (PA1 MOSI, PA3 SCK, PA4 CS, PA5 DC, PA6 RES). Never shares the Si5351 I2C bus.

g.desc: OLED: SPI only (PA1 MOSI, PA3 SCK, PA4 CS, PA5 DC, PA6 RES). Never shares the Si5351 I2C bus.
